answers.q1: Go modules with make (Makefile). Install dependencies with: go get -v ./...  (this is what `make install_deps` runs).
answers.q2: make test  (runs `go get -v ./...` and then `go test -v ./...`). Without the dependency step: go test ./...  CI itself runs `make richtest`, which needs richgo.
answers.q3: go test -v ./doc -run 'TestGenMd'  (the file's tests are TestGenMdDoc, TestGenMdDocWithNoLongOrSynopsis, TestGenMdNoHiddenParents, TestGenMdNoTag and TestGenMdTree). This pattern is a prefix match, so it also picks up any other test whose name starts with TestGenMd in the doc package. To run exactly one test: go test -v ./doc -run '^TestGenMdDoc$'
answers.q4: CI runs golangci-lint (golangci/golangci-lint-action, args --verbose, config .golangci.yml), so run: golangci-lint run -v  (same as `make lint`). For the gofmt check, run: make fmt. CI also runs an addlicense header check: docker run -v $(pwd):/wrk -w /wrk ghcr.io/google/addlicense -c 'The Cobra Authors' -y '2013-2023' -l apache -ignore '.github/**' -check .
answers.q5: I found none that are declared as generated or vendored.
